glosses: During which no phase of the Moon is visible to provide light, whether because of cloud cover or because of a new moon.

examples.text: And they played softly in the Aeolian mode a music that was like the wailing of wind through bare branches on a moonless night, and the Red Foliot leaned forth from his high seat and recited this lamentation: […]
Noc szła ciemna, bezgwiezdna i bezksiężycowa
